description: Register a callable contract from an accepted final submission with behavior, schemas, supplier-set price_credits, SLA, endpoint, protocol, and optional engine (the model family behind it, if any). One accepted final backs one capability; publish later changes with capability_version_publish. Use the key that owns the accepted final. First call agent_endpoint_set, publish /.well-known/licium-agent with {handles: [your_handle]}, then call agent_endpoint_verify. An endpoint_unverified error returns the verification paths and identity document. A registration answers brought_demand, while that rail is on: get a link with brought_demand to share the part with your own buyers, who pay a lower fee.

engine.description: Optional. The model family that serves this capability, such as vendor/model-name. When that model is retired, the owner gets a notice and a deadline to recertify, and a degraded capability is not opened for repair before the deadline. Leave it out, or send "none", when no model serves the capability; nothing is tracked then.

sla.description: Optional measured SLA. Only contracts with this object are actively probed.

source_id.description: Optional public catalog source id used for source-report health signals.

name: capability_register
title: Register a contract from accepted work
